key.name: tray-pos
key.summary: Top bar position for tray indicators
key.description: Anchor position in the GNOME Shell top bar: 'right', 'center', or 'left'.

key.name: tray-order
key.summary: Order index within top bar box
key.description: Placement index (0–10) inside the selected top bar box.

key.name: compact-mode
key.summary: Compact horizontal spacing between tray icons
key.description: Reduces horizontal padding between Shoal top-bar indicators.

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Custom tray icon size override in pixels
key.description: 0 uses automatic GNOME top-bar scaling; 16–48 overrides the icon size in pixels.

key.name: icon-opacity
key.description: Alpha opacity applied to top-bar indicator icons (64–255).

key.name: icon-saturation
key.description: 0.0 renders full color icons; 1.0 fully desaturates icons to monochrome.

key.name: icon-brightness
key.description: Brightness adjustment applied via Clutter.BrightnessContrastEffect (-1.0 to 1.0).

key.name: icon-contrast
key.description: Contrast adjustment applied via Clutter.BrightnessContrastEffect (-1.0 to 1.0).

key.name: legacy-tray-enabled
key.summary: Enable XWayland legacy system tray icons
key.description: Embeds X11/XWayland system tray icons via Shell.TrayManager when enabled.

key.name: scroll-enabled
key.summary: Forward mouse-wheel scroll events to tray applications
key.description: Forwards vertical and horizontal scroll wheel deltas via StatusNotifierItem.Scroll.

key.name: show-settings-in-menu
key.summary: Show Shoal Settings shortcut in indicator menus
key.description: Appends a "Shoal Settings & About…" item to indicator popup menus.
